model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for four different models. The x-axis, labeled "Number of completions (k)", has a linear scale with values ranging from 2^0 to 2^8, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 1 on a logarithmic scale, with units of k. The y-axis, labeled "Coverage", has a linear scale with values ranging from 0.4 to 0.8. There are four lines in the plot: one is blue with circular markers and a solid line style, representing Llama-3B, which starts at approximately 0.45 and ends at 0.85; another is green with triangular markers and a solid line style, representing Llama-3B + FT, which starts at around 0.45 and ends at 0.85; a third is light blue with circular markers and a dashed line style, representing Llama-1B, which starts at approximately 0.4 and ends at 0.75; and the last one is light green with triangular markers and a dashed line style, representing Llama-1B + FT, which starts at around 0.4 and ends at 0.8. Each line exhibits a generally increasing trend across the x-axis.
